title: Interactive Kanban & Study Sprint Board in React 19
brief: Build a responsive, accessible Kanban sprint board in React + TypeScript featuring a pure useReducer state machine, split State/Dispatch Context, keyboard-accessible cards, useDeferredValue search, versioned localStorage persistence, and an Error Boundary.

requirements.text: Model board columns, cards, and actions using strict TypeScript discriminated unions inside a pure `boardReducer`.
Provide board state and dispatch via split Contexts so action-only buttons never re-render needlessly.
Implement add, edit, move-column, and delete card flows using 100% immutable updates and stable card ID keys.
Add instant search filtering powered by `useDeferredValue` with a clear empty state when zero cards match.
Persist board state cleanly through a versioned storage adapter with safe corrupted-JSON fallback.
Wrap the board in an Error Boundary and ensure all modals/forms use semantic labels and `Escape` dismissal.

steps.title: Write Pure Board Reducer
steps.details: Create `boardReducer.ts` supporting add, move, update, and delete actions with `node:test` unit tests.

steps.title: Build Split Board Context
steps.details: Expose `useBoardState()` and `useBoardDispatch()` backed by versioned localStorage hydration.

steps.title: Create Accessible Columns & Memoized Cards
steps.details: Use semantic lists, stable keys, `type="button"` move controls, and `React.memo`.

steps.title: Add Deferred Search Filter
steps.details: Wire a controlled search input to `useDeferredValue` and `useMemo` for lag-free filtering.

steps.title: Build Portal Card Modal
steps.details: Use `createPortal`, `useId`, and an Escape-key effect for an accessible card editor modal.

steps.title: Add Error Boundary & Dark Mode Polish
steps.details: Wrap the board in an Error Boundary and verify desktop + mobile layouts in Light & Dark themes.
